description: List per-day history for The Standard Reserve (TSR)'s license or charter auction on Robinhood Chain, newest day first: open/floor/close price, offered vs. sold, first/last sale time, sold-out time, and minutes to sell out. License days also carry purchase aggregates: transaction_count, distinct_charters, average_price_raw, total_paid_raw, and purchase_size_distribution (licenses bought per transaction to number of transactions); these are null for charter days. Requires kind (license or charter). Page with before (a day number, exclusive) and limit. Fields ending in _raw are 18-decimal integers as strings.
name: 1s_std_auction_days
title: TSR Auction Day History
